notes.title: PlayClaw 7.6340 with Web browser overlay
notes.content:
Hello!
Here is a new release with added Web browser overlay. This overlay cannot automatically set its source size as others overlays so you need to set the size manually in the overlay settings.

Additional changes:
[list]
[*]Added auto-start feature for the Time-shift recording
[*]Added items snapping switch in the editor (snap to the grid and to other items)
[*]Fixed compatibility Vulkan-powered games
[/list]

notes.title: PlayClaw 7.6305 with new Window capture overlay
notes.content:
Hi everybody!
We have uploaded new version 7.6305 with new Window capture overlay and additional useful changes.

[list]
[*]Added Window capture overlay with additional capture mode which became available recently in Windows 10. This method is fast (uses GPU) and it capture windows which were black before (like Chrome). Currently in test mode
[*]Now Time-Shift recording is not linked to regular recording and you can start and stop them separately
[*]Added Cancel recording feature to stop & delete recorded files (if you don't like how you have done last frag because this frag was you ;) )
[*]Fixed bugs with auto start and UWP games capture after latest update with CSGO work-around. And, unfortunately, CSGO is still blocking all 3rd party overlays if you run it in TRUSTED mode
[*]Fixed bug with saving overlay font parameters
[/list]

New features are coming!

notes.title: New build #6285
notes.content:
[h3]Overlays[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added [b]Teamspeak 3 Chat[/b] overlay
[*]Added [b]Teamspeak 3 Voice[/b] overlay
[*]Added teamspeak 3 plugins for these overlays with autoinstaller (PlayClaw will try to find your teamspeak client and add its plugin to teamspeak add-ons folder).
[*][b]HudSight overlay[/b] DLC is now available to purchase, check software store page
[/list]

[u]Please note[/u], new teamspeak overlays are available currently in trial mode. But if you have previous PlayClaw licenses (v5 or v6), then you get this (and everything else) as free update.
Check for quick setup guide at the end of this announcement.

[h3]Editor[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added [b]mouse position[/b] draw option
[*]Added [b]Lock overlay[/b] feature
[*]Extended context menu
[*]Added selection queue when multiple items are under mouse
[/list]

[h3]Capture & render[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed output video render quality, it was blurred
[*]Fixed NV encoder memory leak in some cases
[*]Added new parameters for NV encoder VBR mode
[/list]

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]More convenient configuration interface adopted for different resolutions
[/list]


[h2]Setup guide for Teamspeak 3 overlay[/h2]
Add overlay, for example, Teamspeak 3 chat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37801336/c21c9c2ef7fdf7710654d341273262539c5e03e5.png[/img]


If you see this error message then your Teamspeak 3 client is not started or plugin is not installed properly or you just installed PlayClaw.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37801336/5697f29dc0d2323ca75fdd951328ac78704a043b.png[/img]


Check your Teamspeak 3 add-ons settings. You should see the plugin and it must be enabled.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37801336/d620fa5dbb7f28716d51e5c8c3a2b055928793c7.png[/img]


Send some message in default channel, then get back to scene editor. You will see your message (if it wasn't removed by timeout :) ).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37801336/6defdebf671480c4260949e6063950fb4a6f4c11.png[/img]
